review:
Quick Draw Kate on a 5x5 western grid with DuelReels: when a VS symbol would join a win, it expands into a wild reel and two duelists fight – the winner's 2x to 100x multiplier covers the reel.

The twist is Bounty DuelReels: a bounty hunter faces an outlaw, and if she wins she takes his multiplier and duels again, up to three times, adding as she goes. That chain is how the 20,000x max happens. Three bonus rounds, starting with True Grit, bring more duels.
